mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain deeply depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, discretionary trips are still being suppressed and retail footfall should keep falling over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the previous 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying below -60 and RESIDENTIAL staying above +25.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stops falling and parks mobility stabilizes or improves, households are more likely to resume bundled errand trips that spill into retail locations within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises at least 5 points from its prior weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 5 points and PARKS is flat or higher.

mechanism_narrative: A further decline in TRANSIT below the already extreme level signals continued access limits or voluntary avoidance of shared transport, which reduces retail access and keeps RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days after TRANSIT crosses below -80 and remains there for at least one week.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS improves while RESIDENTIAL remains high, some outdoor discretionary time is substituting for indoor shopping trips, so retail and recreation spending should stay weak over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not underperform over the next 28 days when PARKS rises and RESIDENTIAL stays above +20.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GROCERY_PHARM relative to WORKPLACES indicates people are shifting toward essential, local trips rather than discretionary shopping, which predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds WORKPLACES by at least 30 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM stays at least 30 points above WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week rebound in WORKPLACES from its trough marks the start of reopening, and retail visits should begin to recover within the following week as commuting and shopping are reconnected.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises week-on-week after being below -70
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 7 days after WORKPLACES rises from below -70.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS falls while RETAIL_REC is already deeply negative, demand is not rotating into outdoor leisure and the area remains in a suppressed seasonal pattern that keeps retail mobility weak for four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS drops below -25 after a prior weekly increase
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves over the next 28 days after PARKS falls below -25 following a weekly increase.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL keeps rising and TRANSIT remains near its trough, household substitution toward staying home dominates, so retail-and-recreation mobility should continue drifting down rather than recovering.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises within 14 days while RESIDENTIAL stays above +25 and TRANSIT stays below -75.
